source.title: Solutions to unsolved problems on the minimal energies of two classes of trees

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/7040187 returned HTTP 403 with Cloudflare challenge, classified as blocked_or_challenged.

Identifier-specific recovery via https://api.zbmath.org/document/7040187 succeeded only as resolver metadata. It identified Zbl document 7040187, DOI 10.1016/j.amc.2016.04.006, title 'Solutions to unsolved problems on the minimal energies of two classes of trees', authors Yongqiang Bai and Hongping Ma, Applied Mathematics and Computation 286, pages 49-56, 2016.

DOI and bibliographic resolvers were checked. DBLP record journals/amc/BaiM16 marks access as closed and links only to DOI/unpaywall controls. OpenAlex work W2338581440 reports open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status='closed', best_oa_location=null, any_repository_has_fulltext=false, and has_fulltext=false. Crossref exposes Elsevier DOI metadata and text-mining links, but not readable full text.

Exact-work search attempts used the exact title plus PDF, the exact title alone, and the DOI plus PDF. Inspected candidates were rejected: ScienceDirect DOI/PII landing page was blocked or abstract-only from available fetches; Elsevier API text endpoint returned INVALID_INPUT rather than readable article text; J-GLOBAL was metadata/citation information; OUCI candidate page resolved to a different article ('On the tree with diameter 4 and maximal energy'); DBLP and OpenAlex were metadata-only/closed-access resolvers.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered within the bounded pass. Extraction from abstracts, citation metadata, resolver records, or unrelated works is disallowed.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7040187.json and outputs/latest.json.
